# Faster: sort and then groupby with first after counting
# But pandas groupby + value_counts is parallelized in C for large frames.


import pandas as pd

# Suppress warnings
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
train = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_test_2.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/ru_sample_submission_2.csv")

# Build frequency mapping: before -> most frequent after
# Use value_counts for efficiency
vc = train.value_counts(["before", "after"]).reset_index(name="cnt")
# Get most frequent after per before
vc_sorted = vc.sort_values(["before", "cnt"], ascending=[True, False])
most_frequent_after = vc_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=["before"], keep="first")
before_to_after = dict(zip(most_frequent_after["before"], most_frequent_after["after"]))

# Validation split
np.random.seed(42)
train_len = len(train)
val_size = int(0.05 * train_len)
val_indices = np.random.choice(train_len, size=val_size, replace=False)
val_mask = np.zeros(train_len, dtype=bool)
val_mask[val_indices] = True

train_sub = train[~val_mask].copy()
val_sub = train[val_mask].copy()

# Rebuild mapping on train_sub only (for fair validation)
vc_sub = train_sub.value_counts(["before", "after"]).reset_index(name="cnt")
vc_sub_sorted = vc_sub.sort_values(["before", "cnt"], ascending=[True, False])
most_frequent_after_sub = vc_sub_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset=["before"], keep="first")
before_to_after_sub = dict(
    zip(most_frequent_after_sub["before"], most_frequent_after_sub["after"])
)


# Fallback rules: punctuation etc.
def predict_token_fallback(token):
    # Punctuation
    if token in ". , ; : ! ? - — ... « » ( ) [ ] { }":
        return "sil"
    # Dash variations
    if token in ["—", "-", "–"]:
        return "—"
    # <self> tags
    if token.startswith("<") and token.endswith(">"):
        return token.strip("<>")
    # transliteration
    if token.endswith("_trans"):
        return token
    # months (common in Russian text)
    months = {
        "января",
        "февраля",
        "марта",
        "апреля",
        "мая",
        "июня",
        "июля",
        "августа",
        "сентября",
        "октября",
        "ноября",
        "декабря",
    }
    if token in months:
        return token
    # Unknown Cyrillic -> lowercase
    if re.fullmatch(r"[\u0400-\u04FF]+", token):
        return token.lower()
    # Default: preserve token
    return token


# Validation predictions
val_preds = []
for token in val_sub["before"]:
    if token in before_to_after_sub:
        pred = before_to_after_sub[token]
    else:
        pred = predict_token_fallback(token)
    val_preds.append(pred)

val_labels = val_sub["after"].tolist()
correct = sum(p == l for p, l in zip(val_preds, val_labels))
total = len(val_labels)
accuracy = correct / total
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {accuracy:.6f}")

# Final mapping on full train for submission
vc_full = train.value_counts(["before", "after"]).reset_index(name="cnt")
vc_full_sorted = vc_full.sort_values(["before", "cnt"], ascending=[True, False])
most_frequent_after_full = vc_full_sorted.drop_duplicates(
    subset=["before"], keep="first"
)
before_to_after_full = dict(
    zip(most_frequent_after_full["before"], most_frequent_after_full["after"])
)

# Test predictions
test_preds = []
for token in test["before"]:
    if token in before_to_after_full:
        pred = before_to_after_full[token]
    else:
        pred = predict_token_fallback(token)
    test_preds.append(pred)

# Create submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "after": test_preds})
# Ensure submission order matches sample submission
submission = submission.set_index("id").reindex(sample_sub["id"]).reset_index()
submission.columns = ["id", "after"]
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
